info: Conductors used to transmit electrical power or signals. (e.g., VVG-NG in Russia).
Pressure-sensitive tape used to insulate electrical wires and other materials that conduct electricity.
A female electrical connector that allows plug-in devices to connect to the primary power supply.
A component used to break or connect the electrical circuit, turning lights or devices on and off.
An enclosure housing electrical connections, protecting the wires and preventing shorts.
An automatically operated electrical switch designed to protect a circuit from damage caused by excess current.
Connectors used to safely join two or more electrical wires together without soldering.
A shrinkable plastic tube used to insulate wires, providing abrasion resistance and environmental protection.
A type of fastener for holding items together, primarily electrical cables and wires.
A male electrical connector with pins that fit into a socket to provide power to an appliance.
